737:t_136:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I won't obey you, even if you are emissaries of God.」

737:t_137:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$始原の特異点$$. The $$黒い太陽#sol$$ guided you all this way.」

737:t_137:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But too bad for you. Destroying you will stop the universe's great collapse, so we don't need Singularities anymore.」

737:t_137:2.en:
$$桂$$
「My name isn't Singularity. It's $$桂木桂$$.」

737:t_137:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Your only value is to serve as the key to true spacetime repair... Nothing more.」

737:t_137:4.en:
$$桂$$
「When you treat people like objects to this degree, I don't know whether to be angry or just disgusted...」

737:t_137:5.en:
$$モーム$$
「You could never understand all the good, wonderful things about $$桂$$! $$桂$$ is... $$桂$$ is...!」

737:t_137:6.en:
$$桂$$
「Thanks, $$モーム$$. Having someone nearby who understands me is enough.」

737:t_137:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「But, $$始原の特異点$$, you must atone for the sin of creating the multiverse.」

737:t_137:8.en:
$$桂$$
「You don't have to tell me! That's why I came all this way!」

737:t_137:9.en:
$$桂$$
「I'll start by crushing the old man and little girl pretending to rule the universe! That's my first step!!」

737:t_138:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Now that eight $$スフィア$$s have been lost with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, we must ensure the remaining $$スフィア$$s stay in our hands.」

737:t_138:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$悲しみの乙女$$! If you want, I could make you an officer of the new $$サイデリアル$$!」

737:t_138:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Are you angry? Oh... in your case, you're sad, right!?」

737:t_138:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That is what makes the $$スフィア$$ shine! $$ハマリエル・ザ・スター$$! Come under my command!」

737:t_138:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I am $$セツコ・オハラ$$! I'm a member of the proud $$グローリー・スター$$, and one of $c!」

737:t_138:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll overcome the sorrow you've created and fight!」

737:t_138:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So you can't spread any more needless sorrow through this universe!!」

737:t_139:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So you have come, $$ウェルキエル・ザ・ヒート$$.」

737:t_139:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're a bit overbearing, but I think you'd make a good toy to replace $$エルーナルーナ$$.」

737:t_139:2.en:
$$メール$$
「Darling doesn't belong to you! He belongs to me!」

737:t_139:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「You have no right to say anything about $$メール$$! And of course, the same goes for me and $$ガンレオン$$!」

737:t_139:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've never met anyone who pisses me off this much! $$ガンレオン$$ and I don't need to hold back against these guys!」

737:t_139:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$傷だらけの獅子$$! Will you abandon your role!?」

737:t_139:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「My job is being a repairman, and I'm a member of $c!」

737:t_139:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「Here we come, $$御使い$$s! My role is to beat up villains like you and hammer those twisted attitudes straight!!」

737:t_140:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I was fighting to pay off my debts. I never dreamed I'd run into villains this outrageous.」

737:t_140:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're so petty! You come all this way and still talk about money!」

737:t_140:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Say what you like. That's how humans live, each with their own dreams and goals.」

737:t_140:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I won't be satisfied until I've socked anyone who tries to mess with that for their own convenience!」

737:t_140:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「I acknowledge your strong will, $$ズリエル・ジ・アンブレイカブル$$.」

737:t_140:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Who asked you to acknowledge anything!? You still don't understand your position!」

737:t_140:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit acting like you're our rulers! The moment we got inside your guard, you lost!」

737:t_140:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Brace yourselves, $$御使い$$s! Once I knock you and that huge thing down, I'll smash your sacred $$黒い太陽#sol$$!!」

737:t_141:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$n! You've already achieved your goal, so let's stop fighting.」

737:t_141:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Your goal was to defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. Now that you have, come serve us as a Reactor.」

737:t_141:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「From now on, I'll call you $$アムブリエル・ジ・オーバーライザー$$.」

737:t_141:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Oh... I see. Then I don't need someone like you.」

737:t_141:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Since you have rejected our invitation, you must face the consequences.」

737:t_141:6.en:
$n
「You really have lived 120 million years. Your brains seem to have grown mold.」

737:t_141:8.en:
$n
「You're just like this $$エス・テラン$$. You're already as good as dead.」

737:t_141:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n is right! Understand that there is no place for you in this universe!」

737:t_141:10.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You fool! You would oppose us despite being a Reactor!?」

737:t_141:11.en:
$n
「I'll show you who's foolish, $$御使い$$s! You've made yourselves unnecessary to the universe!」

737:t_141:12.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$n! You're still talking like...!」

737:t_141:13.en:
$n
「Shut up, $$テンプティ$$! I won't let you say another word!」

737:t_141:14.en:
$n
「It's over, $$御使い$$s! We'll defeat you and save the universe!!」
